subject: STRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB1179 (registrar 14c; landed w1018h). GR6: characters move one at a time into the position designated by identifier-4, which increases by one per character and is changed by nothing else. Kernel: chars[pointer-1]=source[j]; pointer++ per character; the emitter writes the pointer back once, BEFORE the ON/NOT ON OVERFLOW phrases (so imperative-statement-1 sees the advanced value) and only when a character moved. Probes: gr8.cob C (P=4, 'XYZ' 'QQ' into X(5)) -> ON OVERFLOW sees P=6, receiver '...XY'; pb664 L1 PTR4 1->0003; pb871 STR3 (dynamic receiver) 5->6. The national identifier-3 arm: pb1179_string_into_national_receiver C (pointer 3 into N(8) -> pointer 07) and pb1179_string_receiver_arms A/B/C/D (national N(3): pointer 1 -> 04 with the overflow before the fourth character; pointer 0 stays 00; pointer 2 -> 04).
